title: The Indentured Engine
logline: A desperate mechanic is trapped on an orbital platform, forced to keep a failing reactor running to pay off their family's debts.

roles.description: Running on stims and terror, coughing from radiation exposure.
Meticulous, bureaucratic, perfectly content to let workers die for margins.
A massive, dangerously unstable power plant.
The massive conglomerate running the grid.

public_situation: The {role:reactor_core} is providing cheap, reliable energy to the sector, overseen by the {role:cruel_foreman}.
private_truth: The reactor is critically unstable. The mechanic is manually overriding safeties daily just to prevent a meltdown.

beats.public_change: The reactor experiences a minor tremor, dismissed by management as 'settling'.

missions.reason: The mechanic begs the pilot to run an external thermal scan to prove the containment vessel is cracking.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the core will breach within days.

beats.public_change: The foreman doubles the mechanic's shift length to 'improve efficiency'.

missions.reason: The pilot must buy and deliver illegal corporate-grade coolants to keep the core stable for one more week.
missions.private_fact: The coolants are highly toxic and will permanently damage the mechanic's lungs.

beats.public_change: The reactor containment begins to buckle.

missions.reason: The mechanic hands the pilot the core's black box data, pleading with them to deliver it to the corporate board.
missions.private_fact: On approach, the foreman hails the pilot, offering to wipe the mechanic's family debt if the pilot hands the data over instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the data to the board.
resolutions.summary: The board panics and shuts down the reactor. The foreman is fired, and the mechanic is finally allowed to go home, though their health is ruined.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a critically unstable reactor before it could vaporize an entire workforce.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the foreman's deal.
resolutions.summary: The mechanic is imprisoned for negligence.
The mechanic flees in an escape pod, leaving the reactor to melt down.

loose_threads.detail: The foreman was receiving massive cash bonuses explicitly tied to delaying necessary reactor maintenance.
The corporate coolants bought on the black market trace back to a supposedly decommissioned corporate black-site.

radio_hooks: Energy output at {role:reactor_core} reaches record highs; management praised.
Whistleblowers silenced at corporate power facility.

voice_direction.exhausted_mechanic: Speaks very slowly, struggling to stay awake, sounds exhausted.
